editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the AWS Certified Security Specialty certification exam. Review detection, incident response, infrastructure security, and data protection domains.
editorial.overview: The AWS Certified Security Specialty certification exam validates advanced technical skills and targeted knowledge in security topics including data protection, identity and access management, infrastructure security, and incident response within complex cloud environments. Certified by AWS, this specialty certification assesses practical cloud security expertise across multiple multi-account cloud deployments while maintaining demanding standards over a duration of 170 minutes.
editorial.who_should_take: Cloud security professionals, architects, and administrators with practical experience securing AWS workloads and data environments should take this specialty exam to validate their technical expertise.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official exam guide domains and objectives carefully during your study period. Focus your preparation time on the practical implementation of security controls, monitoring solutions, incident response plans, and identity strategies across multiple cloud accounts to ensure adequate readiness for the 170-minute exam duration.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your time effectively across the full 170-minute duration. Read each question carefully to identify the specific security requirements for AWS resources before selecting your final answer.

faq.answer_text: The passing score for this specialty certification exam is established at 750 on a scaled scoring range spanning from 100 to 1000 for all qualifying candidates.
The total allocated duration for completing the entire certification examination from start to finish is exactly 170 minutes according to official AWS scheduling and testing policies.

faq.question_title: How much does the exam cost?
faq.answer_text: The standard registration price for taking this specialty certification examination is 300 USD payable directly during the scheduling process on the official certification platform without exception.

faq.question_title: What certifying body offers this exam?
faq.answer_text: This advanced specialty certification credential is officially offered, governed, and administered directly by AWS for qualified cloud professionals seeking formal validation of their security capabilities.
